table.retrieve:
SELECT 
			itemname= item.name, 
			itemalias=item.customicode,
			packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
			remarks=purorderheader.remarks,
			demanddraftno=purorderheader.demanddraftno,
	      amount=purorderheader.amount,
		 deliverylocation=purorderheader.deliverylocation,
         PurOrderHeader.POCode, 
		 headerno=1,  
         PurOrderHeader.Date,   
         PurOrderDetail.ICode,   
         PurOrderDetail.Qty,   
		rate=purorderdetail.rate,
	   gstperc=purorderdetail.gstperc,
	  itemdiscperc=purorderdetail.discperc,
	  invdiscperc=purorderheader.discperc,
	  itemflatdisc=purorderdetail.itemflatdisc,
	 poinvtotal=dbo.fn_getpoinvtotal(purorderheader.pocode),
		stock=purorderdetail.stock,
         Accounts.Name,
	   customername=(select name from accounts AC where AC.acccode=purorderheader.custcode),
			PurOrderDetail.PORowID,
			Manufacturer=(select Manufacturer.name from Manufacturer where Manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
			startdate=PurOrderHeader.startdate,
			enddate=PurOrderHeader.enddate,
			projectiondays=PurOrderheader.Projectionperiod,
			purordercatcode=PurOrderHeader.purordercatcode,
			terms1 =purorderheader.purorderterms1,
			terms2 =purorderheader.purorderterms2,
			terms3 =purorderheader.purorderterms3,
			terms4 =purorderheader.purorderterms4,
			terms5 =purorderheader.purorderterms5,
			terms6 =purorderheader.purorderterms6,
			terms7 =purorderheader.purorderterms7,
			terms8 =purorderheader.purorderterms8
    FROM PurOrderDetail,    
         PurOrderHeader,   
         Accounts, 
         item 
   WHERE ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = PurOrderDetail.POCode ) and  
			( PurOrderDetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
         ( PurOrderHeader.SuppCode = Accounts.AccCode ) and  
         ( ( PurOrderHeader.POCode = :ra_POCode ) )    
ORDER BY
			manufacturer,
			itemname
 /*PurOrderDetail.PORowID
item.icatcode,
			item.packcode, 
			item.iccode

I.manfcode, I.PackCode, I.IcatCode, I.Iccode*/

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: sum(( qty * (rate - itemflatdisc ) ) * ( 1 - (itemdiscperc * 0.01 ) ) for all) * 0.01 * invdiscperc
